game_decline.title: Lower results in "{{game}}"
game_decline.body: In the last 7 days, results were {{pct}}% lower than in the 3 weeks before ({{recent}} games now, {{baseline}} before). Usual level: {{fromLevel}} → {{toLevel}}.
game_decline.tip: Many things can cause this: poor sleep, illness, a new medicine, low mood. If it continues, mention it to the ASHA worker or doctor.

adherence_low.title: Medicines often missed
adherence_low.body: {{taken}} of {{decided}} medicine doses were marked as taken in the last {{days}} days ({{pct}}%).
adherence_low.tip: Check that the reminder can be heard, and whether the times fit the daily routine.

inactive.title: No games for {{days}} days
inactive.body: {{name}} played {{count}} games in the 3 weeks before, and last played on {{date}}.
inactive.tip: A short game together can help. Check that the phone is charged and within reach.

alerts.how: For each game, Smriti compares the last 7 days with the 3 weeks before. Results combine the level reached and the score at that level, because the games get easier or harder by themselves. Medicines: below 70% taken in 7 days. Alerts clear by themselves when things improve.
alerts.disclaimer: This is trend monitoring from games and reminders on this phone, not a diagnosis. Please talk to a doctor about any health worries.

visit.title: Home visit: {{name}}
visit.intro: About 5 minutes: a short check-up with {{name}} (3 small tasks), then a few questions for you.
visit.handOver: Sit with {{name}} and hand over the phone. The app reads every task aloud. The tasks are always the same, so results can be compared from visit to visit.
visit.notePlaceholder: Anything the family told you, or that you noticed
visit.changeSmall: → About the same as last visit
visit.gamesCaption: Played by {{name}} on the family phone
visit.listHint: Tap a patient to see their visits or start a home visit. Patients needing attention are listed first.

falls.q: Any fall since the last visit?

doctor.title: Cognitive trend report
doctor.listHint: Tap a patient for their report. Referred patients and patients with alerts are listed first.
doctor.referredList: Referred by the ASHA worker on {{date}}
doctor.domainsTitle: Abilities (last 2 weeks vs the 2 weeks before)
doctor.weeklySubtitle: All games, 0–100 (level reached + score at that level)
doctor.reaction: Average {{recent}} in the last 2 weeks; {{previous}} in the 2 weeks before. Slower can mean tiredness, illness or medicines.
doctor.how: Every game adapts its difficulty to keep the patient succeeding, so change shows mostly in the level reached. The index (0–100) combines the level (1–5) and the score at that level. Abilities group the games: Memory (Memory pairs, Remember and find, Who is this?), Attention & speed (Catch the fish), Planning & reasoning (Daily routines, Complete the pattern), Recognition & meaning (Find the object, Odd one out). Comparisons are with the patient's own earlier weeks, not with population norms.
doctor.disclaimer: Trend monitoring from games, reminders and ASHA visits recorded on the patient's phone. Not a diagnostic test: please interpret it alongside your clinical assessment.

demoTools.intro: For the presenter: puts the full demo story in the cloud (30 days of games, doses, ASHA visits, alerts, a referral and a doctor's note), so each phone can sign in as one person. Running it again resets the story.
